RACE GUIDE
8th race of JANEV CUP 2026
UCI C1 International race for categories Men, Women, Men Junior
2026 Czech National Youth Championships for categories Men and
Women Beginner, Men and Women Cadet
Veselí nad Lužnicí – 12-13/12/2026
Organiser: Cycling club Jihočeské naděje z.s.
Date: Saturday and Sunday 12 and 13 December 2026
Venue: Veselské pískovny - Hamerská 259, 391 81 Veselí nad Lužnicí II
(49.1729086N, 14.7125514E)
Race Director: Radek Bechyňský
mobile: +420 776 797 360
email: info@cyklokrosveseli.cz
Race Secretary: Josef Bechyňský
mobile: +420 777 802 239
email: info@cyklokrosveseli.cz
Course Director: Radek Bechyňský
mobile: +420 776 797 360
email: info@cyklokrosveseli.cz
President of SCHULZ Anja, GER - UCI races on Saturday 12.12.2026
Commissaires‘ panel: KAŇKA Karel, CZE – Nat. Youth Champ. on Sunday 13.12.2026
Commissaires‘ panel: JANDA Zdeněk, JANDOVÁ Markéta, KAŇKA Karel, MACEK Ondřej, MACHÁČEK
Tomáš, ŠVESTKA Vladislav (only Sunday for the Nat. Champ.), all CZE
Registrations: Registration instructions can be found at https://cycling.sportsoft.cz/. Registrations shall
be submitted to each race separately in electronic form on the website
https://cycling.sportsoft.cz/cyklokros. Please follow the competition guide, race guides,
follow the news at www.cyklokros.cz.
The deadline for registrations and payments is 10 December 2026 at 9:00 am.
Unpaid registrations are invalid. On-site registration at the race office is possible subject
to the conditions set out in the JANEV CUP 2026 Competition Guide.
2026 Czech National Youth Championships for categories Beginners older and
younger, Men Cadets and Women Cadets held on Sunday 13 December 2026 are
open to all riders in above mentioned categories exclusively with the Czech
nationality and a valid license for 2026.
Conditions: All riders must hold a valid licence issued by their national cycling federation for the year
2026. 2026 Czech National Youth Championships are open only to competitors with
Czech nationality.
Racing fee: According to the JANEV CUP 2026 Competition Guide
Race office: Veselské pískovny, Veselí nad Lužnicí (49.1729086N, 14.7125514E)

Start numbers: At the race office on Friday 11 December 2026 from 15:00 to 17:00 and on Saturday
12 December 2026 from 8:00 as follows:
- for MEN JUNIOR no later than 10:15
- for WOMEN no later than 11:30
- for MEN no later than 12:30
On Sunday 13 December 2026 from 8:00 in the race office as follows:
- for WOMEN BEGINNER YOUNGER no later than 08:30
- for WOMEN BEGINNER OLDER no later than 09:00
- for MEN BEGINNER YOUNGER no later than 09:30
- for MEN BEGINNER OLDER no later than 10:15
- for WOMEN CADET no later than 11:00
- for MEN CADET no later than 11:45
On Friday, December 11, 2026, from 15:00 to 17:00., and on Saturday, December 12,
2026, from 8:00 to 15:00, start numbers will also be available for riders participating in
Sunday’s race.
Schedule: Friday 11.12.2026:
14:30–16:00 Official training
Saturday 12.12.2026:
09:30–11:00 Official training
11:10 MEN JUNIOR – C1 (40 min.)
12:15 WOMEN – C1 (45 min.)
13:30 MEN – C1 (60 min.)
14:40–15:00 The awards ceremony of categories MEN, MEN JUNIOR and
WOMEN and the awards ceremony of the overall JANEV CUP 2026
in the following order: MEN JUNIOR, WOMEN, MEN.
14:40–15:30 Official training
Agentura Cyklistika reserves the right to change the start times of individual
categories due to the requirements of Czech Television.
Sunday 13.12.2026:
(Czech National Youth Championships – only riders with Czech nationality)
08:30–09:05 Official training
09:15 WOMEN BEGINNER YOUNGER (a separate start, 20 min.)
09:55 WOMEN BEGINNER OLDER (a separate start, 20 min.)
10:35 MEN BEGINNER YOUNGER (a separate start, 20 min.)
11:15 MEN BEGINNER OLDER (a separate start, 20 min.)
12:00 WOMEN CADET (a separate start, 30 min.)
12:50 MEN CADET (a separate start, 30 min.)
13:40–14:20 Awards ceremony of the National Youth Championships in the order
WOMEN BEGINNER YOUNGER, MEN BEGINNER YOUNGER,
WOMEN BEGINNER OLDER, MEN BEGINNER OLDER, WOMEN
CADET, MEN CADET
and the awards ceremony of the overall JANEV CUP 2026 in the order
WOMEN BEGINNER YOUNGER, MEN BEGINNER YOUNGER,
WOMEN BEGINNER OLDER, MEN BEGINNER OLDER, WOMEN
CADET, MEN CADET
Regulations: Competition runs according to the valid UCI regulations for categories men, women, men
junior, Czech Cycling Federation regulations for categories women and men beginners,
women and men cadet, JANEV CUP 2026 Competition Guide and according to this guide.
In case of violation of the rules, sanctions will be applied according to UCI penalty
regulations for categories men, women, men junior, for the other categories according to
the Czech Cycling Federation rules. Each competitor starts at his/her own risk, the
organizer is not liable for damages incurred or caused by competitors. The organizer
reserves the right to make any necessary technical changes compared the race guide
due to unforeseen circumstances.
Race course: 2700 m, double pit

Awards ceremony: According to the schedule above
Prizes: According to the JANEV CUP 2026 Competition Guide
Doping control: Race office, see map (49.1729086N, 14.7125514E)
Changing rooms, Race office, see map (49.1729086N, 14.7125514E)
showers:
Medical service: Czech Red Cross České Budějovice, Integrated Rescue System South Bohemian Region
Parking: See the map—parking is charged: 350 CZK for caravans, 150 CZK for passenger cars
and vans
Accommodation: The organiser doesn´t organise the accommodation.
Approved by: Jiří Šťastný on behalf of the Czech Cycling Federation Cyclo-cross Committee on
June 4, 2026
Update: 22 July 2026
